descriptions.ring-akoya-5mm: two akoya pearls set side by side on an 18K gold band — modern, versatile, and just distinctive enough to set it apart from the usual single-pearl ring.
descriptions.ring-akoya-ring-3.0mm: a row of small akoya pearls with a soft rosy luster, arcing across the finger like the gentlest smile. delicate, easy to layer, and the kind of ring that lifts your mood each time you wear it.
descriptions.ring-southsea-marine: a south sea pearl paired with a vivid aquamarine, set side by side in polished white gold — two elements of the sea, brought together in one refined silhouette.
descriptions.ring-tahitian: a single tahitian pearl set on a clean, polished band — understated, timeless, and entirely self-assured.
descriptions.ring-southsea-catier: a south sea pearl cradled in a sculptural wave of polished gold — fluid, modern, and quietly striking from every angle.
descriptions.ring-southsea-feather-12.5: a 12.5mm south sea pearl crowned with a spray of diamonds, like frost caught mid-motion — substantial in presence, delicate in detail.
descriptions.ring-akoya-balance: three akoya pearls set in gentle succession across the finger — perfectly balanced, effortlessly elegant, made to be worn every day.
descriptions.ring-keshi: freeform keshi pearls clustered together with delicate diamond accents — organic, sculptural, and entirely one of a kind, like every keshi pearl itself.
